  • AI Software Engineer

    Motus ml

    Oct 2024 - Mar 2026

    Milan, Italy

    • Developed machine learning and data-driven software solutions for industrial applications in the Space Economy and Advanced Manufacturing sectors.
    • Contributed to 3 industrial projects, progressing from full-stack software development to data science and end-to-end AI engineering.
    • Implemented Python-based REST APIs (Flask) and Dockerized microservices to build production-ready software systems integrating ETL pipelines and AI models for customer on-premise environments.
    • Designed and developed an AI-driven defect prediction system for ESA-regulated manufacturing environments, generating thousands of component-level quality predictions across hundreds of PCB assemblies as part of my industrial Master’s Thesis in collaboration with the R&D team.
    • Deployed the solution in customer environments, enabling predictive quality assessment before production and reducing defect analysis time from months to days.
